six_cell.definition: observed = CE(step1-mixed,mixed) - CE(step1-fp32,off); arithmetic = mean over three weight sets; weights = mean over both modes of the step1-mixed minus initial CE

anomaly.cause: the in-process evaluation after step 1 read FP16 projection mirrors converted from pre-step masters; LayerNorm and embedding masters were current, so the loss landed between the initial and updated checkpoints
anomaly.fix: publish the master epoch after the submitted optimizer step (VulkanTransformer::train_step), so a between-step evaluation converts its mirrors from the post-step masters
anomaly.conclusion: the +0.302353 step-one gap was an evaluation-lag artifact; the step-100 mixed/FP32 gap is reproduced by fresh-process evaluation of the exported weights and remains a real drift

analysis.gradient_evidence: not captured; only AdamW updates were compared in Phase XVIII
analysis.softmax_evidence: scores/probabilities are fused in the attention shader and are not separately traced

limitations: raw tensor captures stay under target/phase19r and are not committed
CI verifies compact statistics and evidence hashes, not raw tensors
